name: How do I compare shower installation companies without getting burned?
description: Compare scope, waterproofing, timeline, and what the estimate includes. The lowest bid is not always the best value if key work is excluded.

mainEntity.name: How do I compare shower installation companies without getting burned?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you are comparing shower installers in Denver, Centennial, Greenwood Village, Foxfield, or Parker, focus on scope, waterproofing method, timeline, and what is included in the estimate. The cheapest bid is not always the best value if it leaves out demolition, materials, or cleanup.
